name: Claude Usage
author: Artur Kolecki
description: Claude subscription limits (5-hour session and weekly windows) in the Omarchy bar, with a popup showing every window, its meter and reset time.

barWidget.description: Bar pill with the busiest Claude limit window and a popup listing every window with a meter and reset countdown.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: highest: the most used window only; all: every window; icon: just the icon (details stay in the tooltip and popup).

schema.label: Bar style
schema.description: text: '5h 12%' labels; bars: thin stacked meters.

schema.label: Show weekly (all models) window in bar
Show model-scoped weekly windows in bar
Warning colour
schema.description: Hex colour; empty keeps the theme foreground.

schema.label: Critical colour
schema.description: Hex colour; empty uses the theme's urgent colour.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown before the value; empty hides it.

schema.label: claude-usage script
schema.description: Optional. Path to a claude-usage script; empty runs the copy bundled with the plugin.

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Optional shell command, e.g. omarchy-launch-or-focus-tui claude.
